sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Elastic ECS：三種時間戳與延遲責任分解
related.titleEn: Elastic ECS: three timestamps and latency ownership
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付逐秒佇列表、事件守恆差額、逾齡清單與恢復輸出預算，標明未模型化的磁碟及網路限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver queue traces, conservation residuals, expired-event lists and recovery throughput budgets, naming unmodeled disk and network limits.
related.difference: 保留原始時間字串、時區、事件ID與三種時間欄位，拒絕把攝取時間覆寫為事件發生時間。
related.differenceEn: Preserve raw strings, timezone, event ID and all three timestamps; reject overwriting occurrence time with ingestion time.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恢復後淨排空率為輸出速率減新輸入；若差值不正，增加緩衝只能延後滿載。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成輸入每秒240筆，停機180秒，空佇列容量60000筆；恢復輸出每秒360筆，不計批次額外開銷。 積壓240×180=43200筆；排空時間43200/(360−240)=360秒；這是記錄數模型，不是Exporter批次設定值。
總延遲是代理前等待加代理後傳送；只有時鐘已對齊時，各差值才能作為非負管線延遲。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 同一合成事件以秒為單位：發生100、讀取103、攝取111；所有時鐘共用已明示的時間基準。 前段延遲3秒、後段8秒、總延遲11秒；三段差值必須閉合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Net recovery drain rate is output minus continuing input; nonpositive surplus means buffering only delays saturation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Synthetic input is 240 records/s during a 180-second outage, with capacity 60000 records and recovered output 360 records/s. Backlog is 43200 records; draining takes 43200/(360−240)=360 seconds. These record counts are not exporter batch settings.

Total delay splits into pre-agent and post-agent terms; interpreting them as nonnegative latency requires aligned clocks. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic event occurs at second 100, is read at 103 and ingested at 111, using one stated time reference. Pre-agent latency is 3 seconds, downstream latency 8 seconds and end-to-end latency 11 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Zeek：內容缺口與可觀測流量的分母
related.titleEn: Zeek: content gaps and observable-traffic denominators
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付逐秒佇列表、事件守恆差額、逾齡清單與恢復輸出預算，標明未模型化的磁碟及網路限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver queue traces, conservation residuals, expired-event lists and recovery throughput budgets, naming unmodeled disk and network limits.
related.difference: 把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。
related.differenceEn: Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恢復後淨排空率為輸出速率減新輸入；若差值不正，增加緩衝只能延後滿載。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成輸入每秒240筆，停機180秒，空佇列容量60000筆；恢復輸出每秒360筆，不計批次額外開銷。 積壓240×180=43200筆；排空時間43200/(360−240)=360秒；這是記錄數模型，不是Exporter批次設定值。
教學內容可觀測率=成功重組/(成功重組+已知缺口)；僅在兩者互斥且涵蓋同一內容區間時成立。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成TCP內容區間10000bytes，成功重組9900，已知缺口100；不計重傳與協定標頭。 內容可觀測率9900/10000=99%；不能由此推出99%的事件或封包已被偵測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Net recovery drain rate is output minus continuing input; nonpositive surplus means buffering only delays saturation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Synthetic input is 240 records/s during a 180-second outage, with capacity 60000 records and recovered output 360 records/s. Backlog is 43200 records; draining takes 43200/(360−240)=360 seconds. These record counts are not exporter batch settings.

Teaching content visibility is reassembled/(reassembled+known gaps), assuming disjoint accounting over the same content interval. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic TCP content interval spans 10000 bytes, with 9900 reassembled and 100 missing, excluding retransmissions and protocol headers. Content visibility is 99%; this does not imply that 99% of packets or security-relevant events were detected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
